notes.title: ALONE IN SPACE is available for Mac
notes.notes:
The Mac version is finally done.

Mac requirements
OS: OSX El Capitan, Yosemite, Mavericks, Mountain Lion, Lion
CPU: 1.8Ghz
RAM: 2GB
Graphics Card: 128MB VRAM

The game is very well optimized. It should run on a MacBook Pro 2007 and above. Linux version will follow in the next few weeks. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12052605/0019c15e6c8063e93ead8fa3889028b519fe2bf3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Big update - New content
notes.notes:
For last few months, we were really busy by working on really big update for Alone In Space.
We took your comments to our hearts and made some level design changes to the environment, tweak graphics, add several new puzzles and of course fixed all the bugs we could find. We also add more ship logs and messages to enhance the storyline of our game. Thank you @falagor for correction!
As you may guess all those things took a lot of time, so we don't have Linux and MAC version ready yet. For that, we're really sorry, but we'll start working on them ASAP. Same with localization. We'd like to see our game in most major languages, so if you want to be involved in traslating our game, you are free to go. All English texts can be found in ALONE IN SPACE_Data/StreamingAssets/languages/AIS_ENG.xml.

If you want to get the best experience of Alone In Space, we encourage you to Start a New Game.

notes.title: We fixed several issues
notes.notes:
Among others, Xbox controller now should work with AIS.
We also changed the inventory, so from now on, your objects should remain in your inventory after new level is loaded. But because we had to completely rewrite our inventory system, we recommend you to start new game, after installing this patch.
Those are some major fixes.
Maybe you ask, hey guys, where is Linux and Mac version?
Well, we decided, that we tweak this Windows version of AIS just a little bit, and then port it to other platforms. Therefore Linux and Mac version will come little bit latter. But you can expect some content to be added and maybe some little story twist.

notes.title: Mac and Linux version are under developement. Also translation to other languages is being done.
notes.notes:
We don't forget to users of other than Windows OS. Releasing of the Mac version is scheduled about week from now. Linux version will follow about week after that. If you'd like to participate on translation of Alone In Space game, do not hesitate and contact us at info@aloneinspacegame.com
We'd like translate the Alone In Space game to as much languages as possible. For now, we are working on German and Rusian translation.
You can use English translation as a reference, you can find it in ALONE IN SPACE_Data/StreamingAssets/languages/AIS_ENG.xml directory.
